tools.name: account_show
tools.description: Show the current profile fact. Optional: select. Returns the Profile.

params.name: select
params.description: Comma-separated dotted field paths to project from the response, e.g. id,title,duration. Arrays are traversed element-wise. Reduces token cost when the response carries large nested fields you don't need.

tools.name: classes_catalog
tools.description: List a caller-scoped archived class catalog page. Required: browse_category, content_format. Optional: limit (default: 100), page (default: 0), sort_by (default: original_air_time) (plus 12 more). Returns array of Class.

params.name: browse_category
params.description: Required catalog category.

params.name: content_format
params.description: Required provider content format.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum records per page.

params.name: page
params.description: Zero-based catalog page.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Provider catalog sort field.

params.name: desc
params.description: Sort descending.

params.name: instructor_id
params.description: Optional embedded-instructor filter.

params.name: class_type_id
params.description: Optional provider class-type filter.

params.name: duration
params.description: Optional provider class-length filter, in seconds (e.g. 1800 for 30 minutes). Accepted values are advertised by classes_filters.

params.name: super_genre_id
params.description: Optional provider music-genre filter. Accepted values are advertised by classes_filters.

params.name: has_workout
params.description: Optional tri-state filter: true for classes you've already taken, false for classes you haven't. Omitting the parameter leaves it unfiltered -- omitted and false are different queries.

params.name: is_favorite_ride
params.description: Optional tri-state filter: true for bookmarked classes, false for not-bookmarked. Omitting the parameter leaves it unfiltered -- omitted and false are different queries.

params.name: select
params.description: Comma-separated dotted field paths to project from the response, e.g. data.id,data.title,data.duration. This endpoint's response wraps its items under a top-level "data" key alongside sibling metadata fields -- always prefix paths with "data." (not a bare field name like "id") to reliably reach into the items. Arrays are traversed element-wise. Reduces token cost when the response carries large nested fields you don't need.

params.name: include_stream_urls
params.description: Include per-class stream/playback URLs and join tokens. Default false: these carry no information relevant to choosing a class and dominate response size (measured ~4.5 KB/class with them included).

params.name: include_instructor_bios
params.description: Include each instructor's full bio, Q&A, and share-image array. Default false: these repeat in full for every instructor in the result set regardless of query.

params.name: include_internal_ids
params.description: Include internal cross-reference identifiers per class: home/studio location ids, series grouping id, content licensing tier, and origin locale. Default false: not useful for choosing a class; recoverable via this flag when needed.

params.name: include_flags
params.description: Include per-class is_*/has_* boolean fields (archived, closed_caption_shown, dynamic_video_eligible, explicit, fixed_distance, limited_ride, live_in_studio_only, made_for_radio, outdoor, sessions_eligible, closed_captions, free_mode, pedaling_metrics, tread_pace_target). Default false: not useful for choosing a class. is_favorite is always present regardless of this flag.
